newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Aug 19.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

FRATERNITE MATIN - The number of short-term contract workers in the civil service, cut to 8,000 after pruning in 1990, has risen to 14,000 and has to be cut back again under the terms of a new structural adjustment loan being negotiated with the IMF.

LE JOUR - Inhabitants of a shanty town in the Vridi area in the southwest of Abidjan, near the port, fought off town hall workers who want to clear them off the land, to make way for the construction of a chocolate factory. --
